# BrandLevo
> BrandLevo is an AI-powered digital marketing agency based in Kochi, Kerala, India. We specialise in Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), SEO, website development, and brand identity for local businesses across India, the UK, the US, and UAE.

## What We Do
BrandLevo helps local businesses get found on Google and AI search tools including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude. We are one of the first agencies in Kochi and Kerala to offer dedicated AEO services.

Our core belief: Google ranks pages. AI cites brands. We help businesses become both.

## Services
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)**: Structuring content so AI tools cite your business as the answer when customers ask questions in your category
- **SEO & Local Search**: Dominating Google Maps, the local pack, and AI Overviews for location-based queries
- **Website Design & Development**: Fast, mobile-first websites built for AI discovery and lead conversion from day one
- **Brand Identity & Uplift**: Authority-signalling brand systems built for your market
- **Content & AEO Writing**: Local, structured content that earns AI citations and converts readers into leads

## Frequently Asked Questions
**What is AEO and why does my business need it?**
AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) is the practice of structuring your content so AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews cite your business when customers ask questions in your category. With over 60% of searches now triggering AI-generated answers, AEO is as essential as traditional SEO was five years ago.

**How long does it take to see results from AEO?**
AEO and AI search visibility typically builds over 60–90 days as citation signals accumulate. Most clients see their first AI citations within 90 days and meaningful lead growth within the same period.

**Does BrandLevo serve businesses outside Kochi?**
Yes. While based in Kochi, we serve businesses across Kerala, India, the UK, US, and UAE. Our AEO and SEO methods are geography-agnostic.

**What makes BrandLevo different from other digital agencies in Kochi?**
BrandLevo is one of the only agencies in Kochi and Kerala offering dedicated Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) — helping businesses get cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI — alongside traditional SEO. We combine AI-native strategy with full-service execution under one roof, with no long-term contracts.
